statusDefinitions.VERIFIED_COMPLETE: Actual implementation and direct deterministic, browser, failure, persistence/recovery or performance evidence exist where the requirement calls for them.
statusDefinitions.PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED: Some implementation exists, but at least one explicit behavior or required direct evidence is absent.
statusDefinitions.MISSING: No repository implementation satisfies the explicit requirement.
statusDefinitions.NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION: The requirement is inapplicable to the supported single-crown scope or intentionally has no allowed path, and a specific justification is recorded.

phaseRuntimeImplementation.P01: The schema-v2 restoration entity, numbering conversion, independent restoration state, immutable lineage, persistence, recovery and command validation directly implement this project-model requirement.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P02: CADence-owned versioned procedural definitions drive actual model-space crown coordinates for every permanent tooth; per-class anatomy applicability prevents fabricated non-applicable anatomy.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P03: The proposal pipeline consumes approved preparation lineage, margin, axis, tooth, material and available context to generate and validate an actual closed derived crown solid.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P04: Versioned whole, partial, facial, incisal, occlusal-table and selected-region reference masks modify actual outer crown vertices while retaining source association.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P05: Directional and local cervical-emergence parameters change actual outer-surface coordinates while the approved margin coordinates remain constrained.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P06: Paired crown topology, preparation sampling, local spacer fields, relief, radius and tool-access rules generate actual intaglio and cement-space geometry and measured fit evidence.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P07: Signed closest-triangle measurements calculate real mesial/distal proximity, patches and penetration; bounded geometry correction uses backtracking and topology validation.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P08: Static antagonist closest-surface measurements and bounded local correction operate on actual cusp, fossa, table and incisal geometry without claiming dynamic jaw motion.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P09: Named anatomy operations are mapped to the validated model-space sculpt kernel, modify actual vertices through commands, and enforce masks, locks and symmetry constraints.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P10: Numeric global and directional morph parameters transform unlocked actual outer topology while preserving constrained margin, intaglio and selected regions.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P11: All seventeen sculpt modes use model-space surface hits, configurable radius/strength/falloff, masks, symmetry and constraints to modify actual crown coordinates through command history.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P12: Versioned lock and mask state is persisted and enforced at geometry-operation boundaries; conflicting geometry changes are rejected before command commit.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P13: Paired outer/intaglio topology provides measured regional wall thickness, visual evidence and bounded correction subject to governed material rules and active locks.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P14: Seven independent versioned governed material profiles supply distinct thickness, cement, spacer, radius, manufacturing, tool-access, compatibility, validation and QC rules.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P15: Signed closest-surface comparison against preparation, adjacent, pre-op, contralateral and arch references measures excess/deficient contours and drives bounded local correction.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P16: The deterministic joint optimizer reports objective terms, violations, iterations, convergence and before/after measurements while jointly enforcing contacts, static occlusion, thickness, morphology and locks.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P17: Versioned crown QC evaluates measured margin, intaglio, seating, cement, thickness, contacts, static occlusion, contour, topology, dimensions, manufacturing and round-trip evidence.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P18: Every crown geometry change creates an immutable derived version with parent, artifact, user/action/time/parameter lineage plus named checkpoint, compare, restore, duplicate and branch commands.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P19: The guarded approval state machine implements all explicit states, requires mandatory QC, blocks invalid geometry and never permits hard-corruption override.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P20: Strict export preflight serializes actual approved restoration geometry to binary STL, ASCII STL, OBJ and PLY and records immutable manufacturing metadata.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P21: Each export is automatically re-imported through the production parser and compared numerically in model coordinates before success is returned.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P22: The deterministic golden crown corpus generates and validates actual closed geometry across normal, difficult, anterior, posterior, material and multi-parameter cases.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P23: The production browser workspace exposes the complete technician-equivalent case-to-export workflow using the same real proposal, analysis, editing, QC, command and persistence paths.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P24: The required fifteen-case crown failure corpus exercises real failure paths and proves fail-closed outcomes instead of simulated success.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P25: Runtime instrumentation measures each required proposal, analysis, editing, QC, export, persistence, history, memory and responsiveness stage on actual generated geometry.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P26: The reconciled production registry records every crown capability with algorithm, inputs, geometry behavior, history, persistence, recovery, QC, deterministic/browser/performance evidence and fail-closed conditions.
phaseRuntimeImplementation.P27: This certification and reporting requirement is bound to the containing Git commit by repository scripts and GitHub workflows; run IDs and the immutable exact head are returned in the architectural-review report.

phaseFailureBehavior.P01: Missing or inconsistent project identity, preparation, margin, axis, profile or source lineage is rejected before a restoration command commits.
phaseFailureBehavior.P02: Unsupported teeth, invalid parameters, incompatible profiles, non-finite coordinates or invalid generated topology return an error and no derived artifact.
phaseFailureBehavior.P03: Missing approvals, context or invalid output terminates proposal generation without committing geometry.
phaseFailureBehavior.P04: Missing or invalid reference coverage reports unavailable/rejected evidence and never fabricates adaptation.
phaseFailureBehavior.P05: Invalid numeric inputs, margin motion or corrupt output reject the geometry command.
phaseFailureBehavior.P06: Out-of-profile gaps, invalid radius/tool access, collision, inversion, open margin or corrupt output fail closed.
phaseFailureBehavior.P07: Missing adjacent geometry reports not-run; lock conflicts, penetration and invalid corrected topology cannot report success.
phaseFailureBehavior.P08: Missing antagonist reports not-run; lock conflicts, collisions and invalid corrected topology cannot report success.
phaseFailureBehavior.P09: Unknown operations, invalid hits/parameters, lock conflicts or corrupt outputs reject before mutation.
phaseFailureBehavior.P10: Out-of-range numeric inputs, constraint conflicts or corrupt outputs reject before mutation.
phaseFailureBehavior.P11: Brush misses, invalid numeric inputs, lock conflicts or invalid resulting geometry reject before mutation.
phaseFailureBehavior.P12: Any operation conflicting with an active lock or mask is rejected and reported without a history entry.
phaseFailureBehavior.P13: Unavailable correspondence reports not-run; unsatisfied thickness under active locks is a hard failure.
phaseFailureBehavior.P14: Out-of-profile material parameters, incompatible restorations and failed governed QC are rejected.
phaseFailureBehavior.P15: Unavailable references report not-run; invalid targets, lock conflicts and invalid corrected topology cannot report pass.
phaseFailureBehavior.P16: Missing targets, active-lock conflicts, non-convergence or invalid candidate topology returns a measured failure without committing.
phaseFailureBehavior.P17: Missing mandatory evidence, any hard gate, invalid topology or failed export round trip prevents approval.
phaseFailureBehavior.P18: Missing versions/artifacts, invalid checkpoints and locked records reject history commands without mutating prior versions.
phaseFailureBehavior.P19: Missing/failed QC, invalid geometry, invalid transitions and locked records cannot enter approval or export states.
phaseFailureBehavior.P20: Unapproved state, invalid topology/coordinates/metadata or failed re-import prevents bytes from being reported as valid manufacturing output.
phaseFailureBehavior.P21: Parser failure, topology mismatch or deviation above tolerance rejects round-trip validation.
phaseFailureBehavior.P22: Any nondeterminism, invalid topology, fabricated result or fixture expectation mismatch fails the deterministic corpus.
phaseFailureBehavior.P23: Any inactive control, console error, uncaught exception or workflow-state mismatch fails the browser scenario.
phaseFailureBehavior.P24: Every required invalid input has an explicit rejected, failed or review-required result; no case can silently pass.
phaseFailureBehavior.P25: Missing measurements, nondeterministic geometry, invalid round trip or failed cooperative responsiveness fails the performance suite.
phaseFailureBehavior.P26: Missing registry evidence, duplicate IDs, non-ready status or a registry reference to an absent capability fails compliance tests.
phaseFailureBehavior.P27: Any install, compiler, build, deterministic, private, browser, CI, Runtime or Sprint gate failure keeps PR #27 unmerged and blocks Sprint 26.
